body:
This treasury proposal covers the first milestone of the LexBridge project to enable formation of Etherize DAOs on Edgeware: [https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/948-proposal-lexbridge-legal-entitydocument-panel](https://commonwealth.im/edgeware/proposal/discussion/948-proposal-lexbridge-legal-entitydocument-panel)

_Milestone One: Form: Legal Entity ($10k)_
_Users may form legal entities tied to their EDG/Commonwealth addresses_
_Users may sign legal documents using their Polkadot extension_
_Users may ‘wind up’ their involvement with an entity_
